---
applyTo: "src/routes/**/*.tsx,src/components/**/*.tsx"
---

Read docs/PRD.md and docs/SECURITY.md before changing a user flow. Keep UI components focused on presentation and interaction; use domain calculations for financial values. Preserve mobile usability, visible keyboard focus, semantic controls, accessible names, associated validation errors, meaningful loading and empty states, and screen-reader status announcements. Never treat hidden UI as authorization. Test the correction, filtering, and error path affected by the change.
